```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

packageneeded <- c(
  "quanteda",
  "quanteda.textstats",
  "quanteda.textplots",
  "tidyverse"
)

new_packages <- packageneeded[
  !packageneeded %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]
]

if (length(new_packages)) {
  install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
}

library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textstats)
library(quanteda.textplots)
library(tidyverse)

corp_inaug <- ("Users/patrickheldebrandt/Desktop/EPPS6323/USDOD")

summary(corp_inaug, 5)

table(corp_inaug$Party)
table(corp_inaug$Year)

corp_inaug$period <- case_when(
  corp_inaug$Year < 1900 ~ "Pre_1900",
  corp_inaug$Year >= 1900 ~ "Post_1900",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

table(corp_inaug$period)

toks_inaug <- tokens(
  corp_inaug,
  remove_punct = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE
) %>%
  tokens_remove(stopwords("english"))

dfmat_inaug <- dfm(toks_inaug)

cat("DFM dimensions:", dim(dfmat_inaug), "\n")
cat("Documents:", ndoc(dfmat_inaug), "| Features:", nfeat(dfmat_inaug), "\n")

toks_inaug <- tokens(
  corp_inaug,
  remove_punct = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE
) %>%
  tokens_remove(stopwords("english"))

dfmat_inaug <- dfm(toks_inaug)

cat("DFM dimensions:", dim(dfmat_inaug), "\n")
cat("Documents:", ndoc(dfmat_inaug), "| Features:", nfeat(dfmat_inaug), "\n")

topfeat <- topfeatures(dfmat_inaug, 30)

data.frame(
  feature = names(topfeat),
  freq = topfeat
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(feature, freq), y = freq)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 30 Features across U.S. Presidential Inaugural Speeches",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

textplot_wordcloud(
  dfmat_inaug,
  max_words = 100
)

dfmat_party <- dfm_subset(
  dfmat_inaug,
  Party %in% c("Democratic", "Republican")
)

dfmat_party_grouped <- dfm_group(
  dfmat_party,
  groups = dfmat_party$Party
)

tstat_party_key <- textstat_keyness(
  dfmat_party_grouped,
  target = "Democratic"
)

textplot_keyness(tstat_party_key, n = 20) +
  labs(
    title = "Keyness: Democratic vs. Republican Inaugural Speeches",
    subtitle = "Words more associated with Democratic speeches compared to Republican speeches"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

```
